changes: First release, for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74. LIVE RECORDING records every pad retrig hit as a real trig with the velocity you played, from RTRG + pad and from ALWAYS ON pads; stop recording and the roll plays back as you played it.
Quantize live rec on puts the hits on the steps; off keeps your timing. The live roll sounds where you played it either way.
Rates faster than a step record a trig per step with a step retrig. VEL.CUR records as one fade across the roll, not one per trig.
RTRG + YES turns ALWAYS ON over for the track the RETRIG menu shows.
